pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding into falling knives or consolidation wicks; subsequent scaling entries are strictly forbidden until the primary position achieves a +$10 minimum floating profit and moves stop-loss to breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory order block confirmation combined with an ATR-normalized volatility filter; entries are prohibited within 15 minutes of Tier-1 macro news releases or during abnormal spread expansion.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing and partial profit-taking once open profit crosses +$12.00, ensuring runners expand into the $15-$30+ asymmetrical band.
